bound.rationale: Enclosing gdn_core is the complete-request sink. Recurrence-only leaf timing never admits. Decode commits by pointer swap; prompt carry D2D is unused at the 4096 chunk pin. DRAM is 1 read + 1 write of recurrent (L2 covers the second register pass) plus FP32 conv rings. Roofline upper bound is 0 when compute already exceeds FP32 DRAM time, so shrinking packed traffic cannot shorten gdn_core.
